parameters.content:
# CS - Duplicate ticket handler

Called fire-and-forget by "CS - User eligibility check - first message" when the incoming ticket is NOT the oldest active ticket for that requester.

**Input:** project_key, keeper_ticket_id, loser_ticket_id

Merges the loser into the keeper via POST /tickets/{keeper}/merge. Zendesk sets the loser to **closed** (permanent, not reopenable) and tags it closed_by_merge.

Both merge comments are **private** - the customer is not notified, and the keeper is not bumped out of its current status.

## Safety re-checks (live)

Skips the merge if any of these hold:
- keeper or loser no longer active
- different requesters
- loser has an assignee
- loser has a comment from anyone other than the requester or the automation agent

This makes the handler idempotent and safe to call from the scheduled sweep later.

## The merge call

Body is built in the Code node and serialised with JSON.stringify so ticket descriptions containing quotes or newlines cannot break the payload.

Merge runs as a **background job** - the response is a job_status, not a finished merge. Poll job_status.url if you ever need confirmation.

nodes.name: Apply duplicate label?
nodes.notes: True only when ticket_custom_field_category AND category_value_duplicate_contact are both configured for this brand. Otherwise merge without labelling.

nodes.name: Zendesk: Label loser as duplicate
nodes.notes: Sets the category field on the LOSER to Duplicate contact, before the merge closes it. onError is continueRegularOutput so a failure here never blocks the merge.
